133
RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday, the November 29, 2005/Agrahayana 8, 1927 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Civil Aviation; Company Affairs; Finance;
 Panchayati Raj; Parliamentary Affairs; Petroleum and
Natural Gas; Tourism; Water Resources)
Total number of questions —155
New airport at Mopa, Goa
580.  SHRI SHANTARAM LAXMAN
NAIK: Will the Minister of  CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
construct an airport at Mopa, Goa;
(b) if so, whether necessary land has
been acquired;
(c) the details of the compensation made
so far;
(d) whether the existing airport is
proposed to be closed down;
(e) if not, whether the same is proposed
to be expanded/upgraded; and
(f) if so, the details thereof?
Recommendations of Paul Committee
581.  SHRI R.P. GOENKA:  Will the
Minister of  CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the K. Roy
Paul Committee, set up to suggest ways to
tackle the worsening congestion of flights
over Delhi and Mumbai airports, has
submitted its report;
(b) if so, the details of the major
recommendations made or the action plan
suggested by the Committee; and
(c) the short/long term plans drawn up
to decongest the skies at both the airports
and their present status?
Flights handled by Mumbai and Delhi
airports
582.  SHRI R.K. ANAND:  Will the
Minister of  CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) the No. of airports in the country
which are of international standard;
(b) the No. of flights per hour handled
by Mumbai and Delhi airports; and
(c) what is the international standard
and the reasons for it being so low, when
these two face congestion?

134
Revision in fares of IA and AI
583.  SHRIMATI SUKHBUNS
KAUR: Will the Minister of  CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Indian Airlines and the
Air India have revised air fares and freight
rates during the last three months;
(b) if so, to what extent; and
(c) the reasons for the increase?
Action plan for development of Civil
Aviation in U.P.
†584.  SHRI JANESHWAR MISHRA:
Will the Minister of  CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether any action plan has been
prepared by Government for the
development of Civil Aviation in UP;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
New international airport at Navi
Mumbai
585. SHRI TARIQ ANWAR:
SHRI BALAVANT ALIAS
BAL APTE:
PROF. R.B.S. VARMA:
Will the Minister of  CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) the progress so far made in clearance
of the project proposal for setting up an
International airport at Navi Mumbai from
different authorities concerned;
(b) the salient features of the project,
the infrastructure connected therewith and
the estimated cost thereof; and
(c) the details of its implementation
schedule, so as to be able to meet the
growing traffic needs of Mumbai by
2010-11?
Overhauling of airports in MP,
Karnataka and Chhattisgarh
†586. SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
SHRIMATI PREMA
CARIAPPA:
Will the Minister of  CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) the details of the airports in the
country especially in Madhya Pradesh,
Karnataka and Chhattisgarh proposed to
be identified by Government for
overhauling and to bring them upto
international standard;
(b) whether Government would also fix
time frame to complete the construction
work of these airports, if so, the details
thereof; and
(c) the total expenditure likely to be
incurred in the construction of each of it?
Norms on passenger aircraft cockpit
door
587.  SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA: Will
the Minister of  CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
Directorate General of Civil Aviation has
revised the norms for making  the passenger
aircraft cockpit doors bulletproof;
(b) if so, the details of the revised norms
and how the revised norms  are different
from the existing ones; and
(c) whether the DGCA has
recommended any new norms for security
training course to crew members?
Modernisation of non-metro airports
588.  SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO: Will the Minister of  CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that
Government are moving swiftly to

help of private players;
(b) if so, the details of the airports
identified by the AAI, State-wise;
(c) whether it is also a fact that no airport
from Andhra Pradesh has been identified
for modernization;
(d) whether any time-frame has been
fixed to modernise the non-metro airports;
and
(e) whether the proposal has been
scrutinised by the Committee on
Infrastructure?

pleased to state:

by Government to reduce delays due to
lack of take-off and landing space at major
airports like Delhi;
